fact: The terms of reference state the RSU holds about 977,600 households (4,860,075 individuals) and that the FDSI signed a partnership on 27 June 2024 with ANIES to extract beneficiaries from the RSU for the food shock window, alongside UNICEF, SOS Guinée and SWEDD links.
title: Termes de Référence pour l'analyse du profil socio-démographique et socio-économique des ménages enregistrés dans le RSU
